categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: Every product is filed under one of these. Sellers send its id when they list a product; product filters, search and pricing's category discounts match its slug.
categories.list.title: All categories
categories.list.empty: No category exists yet. Create the first one.
categories.idle.title: Nothing chosen
categories.idle.body: Choose a category to rename or delete it, or create a new one.
categories.create.title: New category
categories.create.lead: Sellers can file products under it as soon as it exists.
categories.field.name: Name
categories.field.nameHint: What buyers and sellers read. No other category may use it.
categories.field.slugHint: Letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. No other category may use it.
categories.rule.nameNul: The name cannot hold a NUL character.
categories.rule.slugShape: Use 1 to 128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, with no spaces.
categories.edit.slugWarning: Pricing's category discounts name the slug: a discount set on “{slug}” stops applying to these products once the slug changes.
categories.edit.searchNote: Catalog's own product filter uses a new name or slug at once; search shows it after its next sync.
categories.delete.body: A category can be deleted only while no product is filed under it, withdrawn products included.
categories.delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
categories.delete.confirmBody: Sellers can no longer file products under it, and the slug is free again. This cannot be undone.
categories.failure.taken: Another category already uses this name or this slug.
categories.failure.inUse: Products are still filed under this category, withdrawn ones included. Their merchants have to move them to another category first.
categories.failure.gone: This category no longer exists: someone deleted it. The list has been read again.
categories.keys.label: Keyboard shortcuts
categories.figure.caption: {count} categories, a drawer each
